glosses: Often preceded by in or into: to inset (something) into a recess or niche.

examples.text: That gargoyle recesses into the rest of architecture.
Recess the screw so it does not stick out.

glosses: To conceal, to hide.

examples.text: Get near fat Mr. Dutton, and behind the screen of his prodigious elbow, you will be comfortably recessed from curious impertinents.

glosses: To temporarily suspend (a meeting, the proceedings of an official body, etc.).

examples.text: When Congress is recessed, he makes himself acquainted with those free United States, of which he is the gifted son.

glosses: To make a recess appointment in respect of (someone).

examples.text: To the National Rifle Association's delight, the Senate has hobbled the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives by failing to confirm a director since 2006, but [Barack] Obama hasn't made a recess appointment. […] "The President's view of his own power is a constrained one," says White House counsel Kathryn Ruemmler. "Many of his nominees have languished, but he's only recessed the ones that were critical to keep agencies functioning."

glosses: Of a meeting, the proceedings of an official body, etc.: to adjourn, to take a break.

examples.text: Class will recess for 20 minutes.

glosses: Of an official body: to suspend proceedings for a period of time.

examples.text: This court shall recess for its lunch break now.

glosses: Que tiene una cavidad, vacío, espacio no lleno en su interior.

examples.text: Un viejo árbol con el tronco hueco.

glosses: Que es blando y suave, como una esponja.

examples.text: Un sofá hueco.

glosses: Que tiene un sonido grave y retumbante, como el que se produce en algunas cavernas o al golpear un tambor grande.

examples.text: Una voz hueca.

glosses: Que hace ostentación de importancia, que presume.
Se dice del escrito, estilo o forma de expresarse afectada y grandilocuente, pero carente de contenido.
Que siente atracción por las personas de su mismo sexo biológico.
Abertura grande o espacio vacío en el interior de un cuerpo.

examples.text: El hueco del ascensor.

glosses: Espacio libre, cuando la mayor parte ya está ocupado.

examples.text: Encontrar un hueco para estacionar el auto.

glosses: Pequeña cantidad de tiempo disponible, cuando la mayor parte del tiempo ya está ocupada con alguna actividad.

examples.text: El doctor tiene su agenda copada hasta el lunes, pero le buscaré un hueco para que lo pueda ver el viernes.

cavità, in un appartamento o ville e simili, è parte di un muro spesso “abbellita” con incisioni varie, con una base apposita ove riporre oggetti, quali abat-jour, opere d’arte oppure libri… In molti casi vengono addirittura ricollegate a strutture di arredamento costruite con la medesima tecnica ma risultando normalmente utili come scrivanie oppure nella forma dei “classici” mobili/armadi a muro con le stesse caratteristiche artistiche… persino parti di bagni come ampie docce, vasche e “piscine coperte”.
